metadata.description: small, quiet claude code mods with the lofi puppy

plugins.name: puppy-todo
plugins.description: your own to-do list in a quiet pane: add, tick, delete. nothing else writes to it

plugins.name: puppy-sessions
plugins.description: your claude conversations in a pane: the ones that wait for you to answer, one row for each of the others, your rate limits, and the finished ones you may archive

plugins.name: puppy-skills
plugins.description: a pane listing your skills and mods, where each one works, and which skills a schedule uses

plugins.name: puppy-theme
plugins.description: the puppy's look for the desktop app: warm grey colors, a framed sky that follows the time of day, pixel message cards and soft sounds
